paper_title: Few-shot Hate Speech Detection Based on the MindSpore Framework
caption: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate.
model_annotation: The line chart presents an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, illustrating the performance of different model variants of MS-FSLHate in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays five categorical categories: "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation," arranged from left to right. The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66 with major tick marks at intervals of 2, and minor gridlines at intervals of 0.5. Three lines represent the metrics: precision (purple with circular markers), recall (blue with circular markers), and F1-score (brown with circular markers), each with a solid line connecting the data points. For the "Full model (Ours)" variant, precision is 65.49%, recall is 65.56%, and F1-score is 65.78%. In the "w/o Prompt" variant, precision drops to 61.06%, recall to 59.64%, and F1-score to 60.16%. For "w/o Augmentation," precision is 63.75%, recall is 62.63%, and F1-score is 62.22%. In the "w/o Attention" variant, precision increases to 64.06%, recall decreases to 59.17%, and F1-score is 59.67%. Finally, for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation," precision is 65.44%, recall is 56.82%, and F1-score is 57.74%. Each data point is annotated with its exact numerical value.
